title: Representing biological concepts as directions in foundation model embeddings
one_liner_zh: 该文在蛋白质基础模型嵌入中利用概念激活向量（CAV）将生物概念映射为方向，用于恢复GO/EC注释、定位Pfam结构域和捕获界面特异性，虽以蛋白质结构相关属性为对象且使用AI方法，但核心是嵌入空间的可解释性分析而非结构预测/采样/生成等计算建模，故评6分。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Biological foundation models encode rich information about protein structure, function, and cellular state in high-dimensional embeddings, but accessing specific biological properties typically relies on additional, task-specific prediction models. Here, we show that diverse biological properties can be mapped to interpretable, reusable directions in embedding space. In the Concept Activation Vector (CAV) approach, examples representing a concept are distinguished from a background set using a linear model, and the resulting weight vector defines the CAV for that concept. In protein embeddings, CAVs recover Gene Ontology and Enzyme Commission annotations, localize Pfam domains, reveal novel structural relationships, and capture DNA-binding and protein-interaction interface specificity. In single-cell embeddings, CAVs isolate cancer-associated expression transitions, and gene variation along these axes substantially agrees with conventional differential-expression analysis despite being a distinct computational approach. Together, these results establish concept directions as a common representation, enabling diverse biological features to be compared, localized, and manipulated.
abstract_zh:
摘要

生物基础模型在高维嵌入中编码了关于蛋白质结构、功能和细胞状态的丰富信息，但访问特定生物学特性通常依赖于额外的、任务特定的预测模型。在此，我们表明多种生物学特性可以被映射到嵌入空间中可解释、可复用的方向。在概念激活向量（Concept Activation Vector, CAV）方法中，代表某一概念的示例通过线性模型与背景集区分，所得权重向量即为该概念的CAV。在蛋白质嵌入中，CAVs恢复了基因本体（Gene Ontology）和酶委员会（Enzyme Commission）注释，定位了Pfam结构域，揭示了新颖的结构关系，并捕获了DNA结合和蛋白质相互作用界面的特异性。在单细胞嵌入中，CAVs隔离了与癌症相关的表达转变，且沿这些轴的基因变异与常规差异表达分析基本一致，尽管这是一种不同的计算方法。综合这些结果，确立了概念方向作为一种通用表示，使得多样化的生物学特性能够被比较、定位和操作。
